text:
Situation: Levofloxacin is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 238 tablets of 750 mg (15.7 days) and 315 tablets of 500 mg (18.4 days). Corvale General holds 207 tablets of 750 mg (13.6 days) and 394 tablets of 500 mg (25.2 days). The 750 mg strength at Corvale General is below the 14-day target.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include levofloxacin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs but the 750 mg strength at Corvale General is thin. No FDA shortage declaration exists to trigger allocation programs. Procurement should proceed through standard channels using vetted suppliers.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders for 750 mg tablets from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (supplied from Hetero Labs Limited Unit V, last inspected VAI 2022-08-12) to replenish Corvale General; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer places orders for 500 mg tablets from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to maintain stock at both sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer qualifies Aurobindo Pharma Limited, Chartwell RX, LLC, Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited, and Major Pharmaceuticals as backup sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer monitors daily usage and adjusts reorder points for 750 mg strength; requires Inventory Manager approval.

Not recommended: No allocation requests, therapeutic substitutions, or emergency purchases at this time.
